name: Olam Group Limited
summary: Olam Group Limited, a Singapore-headquartered company founded in 1989, operates as a global agribusiness and food ingredient enterprise. Its worldwide operations encompass the sourcing, processing, packaging, and distribution of an extensive range of agricultural products. The company functions through three main divisions: Olam Food Ingredients (OFI), Olam Global Agri (OGA), and Olam International Limited. Within its Olam Food Ingredients segment, the company provides diverse offerings including various cocoa products like powder, liquor, and butter, alongside specialized fats such as vegetable fats, cocoa butter equivalents, and confectionery fats, marketed under brands like deZaan, Unicao, and Joanes. OFI's portfolio also features coffee; a broad selection of dairy ingredients including whole, skimmed, and butter milk powders, butter, anhydrous milk fat, cheese, and various milk and whey protein concentrates; nuts like almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, peanuts, sesame, quinoa, and chia seeds; and spices such as chillies, onion, garlic, and pepper. The Olam Global Agri segment focuses on commodities including cotton, edible oils (palm, soybean, and sunflower), animal and fish feeds, proteins, a wide array of flours for different applications (breads, pasta, biscuits), rubber, rice, and timber products. Beyond raw and processed ingredients, Olam Group Limited also markets branded consumer products. These include biscuits under names like Perk and King Cracker; tomato mixes such as Tasty Tom and De Rica; Tasty Tom Jollof Mix; FreshYo drinking yogurt; OK Pop lollipops; and noodles from brands like Cherie Noodles and Tasty Tom. Furthermore, the company's activities extend to poultry breeding farms and day-old-chick hatcheries. It also delivers essential commodity financial and risk management services, comprehensive infrastructure and logistics support, and specialized sourcing solutions for agricultural raw materials and food ingredients.
